# `luhn_check`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Checks that a string of digits is valid according to the Luhn algorithm.
This checksum function is widely applied on credit card numbers and government identification
numbers to distinguish valid numbers from mistyped, incorrect numbers.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
luhn_check(str )
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- luhn_check, example 1
> SELECT luhn_check('8112189876');
true
```

```sql
-- luhn_check, example 2
> SELECT luhn_check('79927398713');
true
```

```sql
-- luhn_check, example 3
> SELECT luhn_check('79927398714');
false
```
